title: Set PulseAudio card profile
summary: Change the audio profile of a sound card (e.g., from stereo to surround). This affects which inputs and outputs are available.

steps.explain: Set the profile for a specific card. Replace <CARD_INDEX> with the card index (e.g., 0) and <PROFILE_NAME> with the desired profile name.

placeholders.name: CARD_INDEX
placeholders.description: The index of the sound card.

placeholders.name: PROFILE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the profile, e.g., 'output:analog-stereo+input:analog-stereo'.
